_about: Everything a merchant can sell. Each island's merchant sells one family. Every item comes in four rarities; the arrays below are [common, uncommon, rare, legendary]. A rune's rarity is its condition: broken, cracked, fine, pristine. Strong suits and weaknesses are on purpose: no item saves you from everything. Build 52: weapons and armor pieces are gear with a "piece" (weapon, helmet or body); "acts" names the item whose behavior a new item borrows; "hit" is the damage tags of its blows (docs/DAMAGE.md); "stats" are its stat lines, and its rarity sets how many it has (statsByRarity); armor pieces of one "set" (armorSets) give the set's bonus when both are worn.

slots.name: Gear
slots.help: Worn all the time. One at a time. Yours for good: it absorbs one hit a level, one more for each part fitted at the workbench and one for a trinket, and it's whole again every level.

slots.name: Helmet
slots.help: Armor for your head. One at a time. Yours for good: it never wears out, and its stat lines work in every level. Wear the body piece of the same set too for the set's bonus.

slots.name: Body armor
slots.help: Armor for your body. One at a time. Yours for good: it never wears out, and its stat lines work in every level. Wear the helmet of the same set too for the set's bonus.

slots.name: Spell
slots.help: Press Space to cast. One at a time. Yours for good: its charges come back every level, and the Arcanum Spire's lectern levels it up.

slots.name: Snack
slots.help: Goes in your pocket, which holds four. Press 1 to 4 in a level to eat one; each bite spends a charge.

slots.name: Familiar
slots.help: Comes along beside you into every level and never wears out. One at a time; choose it before a level.

slots.name: Rune
slots.help: Yours for good: a rune never wears out or burns up. One is active at a time, shown under your hearts, and its good side and its bad side both work in every level. Swap it or take it off whenever you're not in a level.

slots.name: Canister
slots.help: Extra hearts in a jar. Its purple hearts and armor are lost first and never come back; when they're all gone, so is the jar. One at a time.

weaponTraits._about: What a weapon's (or spell's) traits do. Each comes from a damage tag: burn (fire), chill (ice), shock (electricity), toxin (venom), pierce (piercing), cleave (slashing).

burn.name: Burn
burn.text: A boss it strikes burns for one more blow a moment later, unless it shrugs off fire.

chill.name: Chill
chill.text: A boss it strikes freezes for a moment; an enemy it cuts down chills the hazards around you.

shock.name: Shock
shock.text: An enemy it cuts down zaps the next nearest enemy too.

toxin.name: Toxin
toxin.text: A boss it strikes is poisoned: it tires half again as fast for a while.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.text: Its blows on a boss's armor go through: one more piece of armor off.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: An enemy it cuts down takes the ones beside your head with it.

items.name: Kite Shield
items.does: Blocks a hazard or enemy you run into and shoves it aside.
items.strong: Rocks, bees, fleas, ghosts, brambles, spikes, popsicles
items.weak: No help against walls, fire, lightning or blasts, and a shoved bee comes right back.
items.legend: Rocks bounce off without wearing it down.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.does: Kills any enemy you hit: bees, fleas, ghosts, rival snakes. Against a boss it cracks armor.
items.weak: Hitting a hazard knocks it aside but snaps the blade. Useless against walls.
items.legend: Hazards never snap the blade: they only cost one use.

items.name: Bulwark Helm
items.does: Your head bounces off a wall instead of crashing.
items.strong: Walls, inner walls, the edges of the board
items.weak: Does nothing at all against hazards or enemies.
items.legend: Spikes and brambles shatter against it, and that costs nothing.

items.name: Ember Cloak
items.does: Shrugs off the elements: fire, lightning strikes, bomb blasts and frost.
items.weak: Cloth, not steel: rocks, enemies and walls go straight through it.

items.name: Thorn Mail
items.does: Armors your body: biting your own tail passes through, and anything that bites your body gets pricked.
items.strong: Your own tail, rival snakes and bosses biting your body
items.weak: Your head is bare. Anything you run into face-first still hurts.
items.legend: Your own tail never wears it down.

items.name: Barbed Dagger
items.does: A quick, wicked little blade. Kills what you run into, and its barbs find the gaps in a boss's armor.
items.weak: Short: it adds little to a blow. Ghosts, knightlings and scorpions shrug off the point.
items.legend: Its blows land twice as hard.

items.name: Boar Spear
items.does: A long spear with a crossbar. Kills what you run into, and punches through a boss's armor.
items.weak: Ghosts, knightlings and urchins turn the point.
items.legend: Every blow on a boss lands two harder.

items.name: Woodsman's Axe
items.does: A heavy axe. Kills what you run into, and everything beside your head goes with it.
items.weak: Crabs, knightlings and the Black Knight turn the edge.

items.name: Flamebrand
items.does: A blade that never stops burning. Kills what you run into, and sets bosses alight.
items.weak: Fire-born foes (wisps, cinder bats, the Cinder Wyrm) don't feel it at all.
items.legend: Three harder on every blow, and the burn.

items.name: Rimefang
items.does: A sword of blue ice. Kills what you run into; a boss it strikes freezes for a moment.
items.weak: Frost sprites and the Drowned Queen are made of the stuff. Leviathorn barely notices.

items.name: Storm Maul
items.does: A hammer that crackles. Kills what you run into, and the spark leaps to the next enemy.
items.strong: Crabs, knightlings, urchins, Leviathorn, the Black Knight
items.weak: Spark beetles drink it up, and the Stormwright is immune.

items.name: Viper's Kiss
items.does: A green-edged blade. Kills what you run into, and poisons bosses so they tire faster.
items.strong: Spark beetles, the challengers' champions, long boss fights
items.weak: Ink wraiths are immune, and vipers and the hunter resist it.

items.name: Moon Glaive
items.does: A curved blade of cold moonsteel. Cuts down what you run into and what's beside it, and chills bosses.
items.weak: Two tags, two chances to be resisted: crabs and frost sprites barely notice.

items.name: Dune Scimitar
items.does: A curved desert blade, light in the hand. Kills what you run into, and takes the ones beside your head with it.
items.weak: Crabs and ghosts barely feel an edge.

items.name: Cinder Whip
items.does: A lash of braided embers. Cuts down what you run into and what's beside it, and sets bosses alight.
items.weak: Two tags, two chances to be resisted: wisps and imps laugh at the fire.

items.name: Glacier Pick
items.does: A climber's pick with a head of blue ice. Kills what you run into, chills bosses, and punches through armor.
items.weak: Frost sprites and ghosts don't mind the cold or the point.

items.name: Hornet Lance
items.does: A yellow-banded lance with a stinger on the tip. Kills what you run into, punches through armor, and poisons bosses.
items.weak: Hunters and spark beetles shrug off venom and the point.

items.name: Hide Cap
items.does: A cap of boiled leather. Better than nothing.
items.weak: Okay armor: a little of everything, not much of anything.

items.name: Hide Jerkin
items.does: A stiff leather jerkin.
items.weak: Okay armor: a little of everything, not much of anything.

items.name: Mail Coif
items.does: A hood of steel rings.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and lightning loves you: Electric Weakness.

items.name: Chain Hauberk
items.does: A long shirt of steel rings.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and lightning loves you: Electric Weakness.

items.name: Beekeeper's Veil
items.does: A wide hat with a net to the shoulders.
items.weak: Smoke and cloth: the whole set burns easily (Fire Weakness).
items.legend: Barb Immunity: no sting gets through.

items.name: Beekeeper's Smock
items.does: A thick white smock, smelling of honey.
items.weak: Smoke and cloth: the whole set burns easily (Fire Weakness).

items.name: Frostguard Hood
items.does: A hood of white fur.
items.weak: Fur and fire don't mix: the whole set has Fire Weakness.

items.name: Frostguard Coat
items.does: A long white fur coat.
items.weak: Fur and fire don't mix: the whole set has Fire Weakness.
items.legend: Rime Immunity: frost can't touch you.

items.name: Emberforged Helm
items.does: A helm hammered out in a volcano.
items.weak: Hot metal cracks in the cold: the whole set has Ice Weakness.

items.name: Emberforged Mail
items.does: Mail that glows faintly orange.
items.weak: Hot metal cracks in the cold: the whole set has Ice Weakness.
items.legend: Ember Immunity: embers can't touch you.

items.name: Copper Circlet
items.does: A thin copper band that hums.
items.strong: Lightning, the climb to the last lair, spells
items.weak: A robe, not a coat of steel: the whole set has Piercing Weakness.

items.name: Stormcaller's Robe
items.does: A dark blue robe stitched with silver bolts.
items.weak: A robe, not a coat of steel: the whole set has Piercing Weakness.
items.legend: Spark Immunity: sparks can't touch you.

items.name: Serpentscale Helm
items.does: A helm of green snake scales.
items.weak: Cold-blooded: the whole set has Ice Weakness.

items.name: Serpentscale Vest
items.does: A vest of overlapping green scales.
items.weak: Cold-blooded: the whole set has Ice Weakness.
items.legend: Venom Immunity: no poison gets through.

items.name: Knight's Great Helm
items.does: A bucket of steel with a slit to see through.
items.weak: Steel calls lightning: the whole set has Electric Weakness.

items.name: Knight's Cuirass
items.does: A polished breastplate.
items.weak: Steel calls lightning: the whole set has Electric Weakness.
items.legend: An armor plate of its own.

items.name: Arcanist's Star Hat
items.does: A tall pointed hat sewn with stars.
items.weak: Cloth: the whole set has Piercing and Slashing Weakness.
items.legend: Fire and ice spells hit harder.

items.name: Arcanist's Starweave
items.does: A robe woven from night sky.
items.weak: Cloth: the whole set has Piercing and Slashing Weakness.
items.legend: Lightning and venom spells hit harder.

items.name: Wyrmscale Helm
items.does: A horned helm from a wyrm's shed skin.
items.weak: Great armor, and it costs like it.

items.name: Wyrmscale Mail
items.does: Mail of scales as big as your head.
items.weak: Great armor, and it costs like it.
items.legend: An armor plate of its own.

items.name: Mossback Cap
items.does: A felted cap with moss growing on the crown.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and fire loves the moss: Fire Weakness.

items.name: Mossback Cloak
items.does: A cloak so overgrown you can hardly tell it from the ground.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and fire loves the moss: Fire Weakness.

items.name: Glasswing Hood
items.does: A hood of spun glass, thin as a wing.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and every blade and barb finds you: Slashing and Piercing Weakness.

items.name: Glasswing Vest
items.does: A vest of glass scales that sings when you move.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and every blade and barb finds you: Slashing and Piercing Weakness.

items.name: Pilgrim's Hat
items.does: A wide brown hat, worn thin by the road.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and you're easy prey: you take more damage.

items.name: Pilgrim's Coat
items.does: A long coat with a gold clasp and a great many pockets.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and you're easy prey: you take more damage.

items.name: Force Field
items.does: A bubble that soaks up hazards and enemies for a few seconds.
items.weak: Walls pop it instantly.
items.legend: Also bounces you off one wall.

items.name: Fireball
items.does: A homing fireball that burns the nearest enemy or hazard. On a boss it cracks a heart of armor.
items.strong: Bees, ghosts, brambles, bombs, rival snakes, boss armor
items.weak: Can't burn rocks or walls, and never touches a boss's bare heart.
items.legend: Each fireball splits and burns two targets.

items.name: Blink
items.does: Teleports your whole snake forward, straight through whatever is in the way.
items.weak: Only goes straight ahead, and it won't jump you into a wall.
items.legend: You're untouchable for a second after landing.

items.name: Frost Nova
items.does: Freezes every hazard and enemy in place.
items.weak: A boss only freezes for half as long, and frozen things still hurt to touch.
items.legend: A frozen boss loses stamina while it's frozen.

items.name: Apple Call
items.does: Apples slide toward your head for a while.
items.weak: Not a scrap of protection.

items.name: Ice Lance
items.does: A shard of ice that flies at the nearest enemy or hazard. On a boss it cracks a heart of armor and freezes it a moment.
items.strong: Bees, wisps, cinder bats, the Cinder Wyrm
items.weak: Frost sprites and the Drowned Queen are made of ice. Can't break rocks or walls.
items.legend: Each lance splits and hits two targets.

items.name: Chain Spark
items.does: Lightning that leaps between the nearest enemies and hazards.
items.weak: Spark beetles and the Stormwright are immune, and it never touches a boss's bare heart.

items.name: Venom Bolt
items.does: A bolt of venom at the nearest target. A boss it hits tires faster for a while.
items.weak: Ink wraiths are immune; vipers and the hunter resist it.
items.legend: Each bolt splits and hits two targets.

items.name: Flame Shroud
items.does: A ring of fire around you for a few seconds: it soaks up hazards and enemies, and while it burns you have Fire Immunity.
items.weak: Walls put it out at once, and fire-born bosses walk right through it.
items.legend: Also bounces you off one wall.

items.name: Gale Step
items.does: A gust carries your whole snake forward, straight through whatever is in the way.
items.strong: Getting out of a corner, again and again
items.weak: Only goes straight ahead, and it won't drop you in a wall.
items.legend: You're untouchable for a second after landing.

items.name: Rime Ward
items.does: A ring of frost around you for a few seconds: it soaks up hazards and enemies, and while it holds you have Ice Immunity.
items.weak: Walls shatter it at once, and fire-born bosses walk right through it.
items.legend: Also bounces you off one wall.

items.name: Thorn Ring
items.does: A ring of living thorns around you for a few seconds: it soaks up hazards and enemies, and while it grows you have Piercing Immunity.
items.strong: Bees, wasps, fleas, spikes and brambles
items.weak: Short-lived, and walls put it out at once.
items.legend: Also bounces you off one wall.

items.name: Razor Gust
items.does: A blade of wind that flies at the nearest enemy or hazard. On a boss it cracks a heart of armor.
items.weak: Crabs and ghosts shrug it off. Can't break rocks or walls.
items.legend: Each gust splits and hits two targets.

items.name: Skip Step
items.does: Two quick hops: your whole snake skips forward, straight through whatever is in the way.
items.strong: Short gaps, tight mazes, using it over and over
items.weak: It doesn't go far, and it won't drop you in a wall.
items.legend: You're untouchable for a second after landing.

items.name: Hearty Stew
items.does: Eat it to heal hearts.
items.weak: Can't heal past your full hearts, and does nothing if you have none.

items.name: Honey Bread
items.does: Eat it to grow back an armor plate.
items.strong: Anyone with armor plates from the Warding Willow
items.weak: Useless if your armor is whole, or if you have none.

items.name: Tinker's Pie
items.does: Eat it to patch up your gear: worn uses come back.
items.strong: Keeping a good shield or sword alive
items.weak: Does nothing without gear, or if it's good as new.

items.name: Spice Jerky
items.does: Eat it to put charges back in your spell.
items.weak: Does nothing without a spell, or if it's fully charged.

items.name: Phoenix Tart
items.does: Eat it, and the next blow that would end you this level won't: you rise again with a moment of safety.
items.weak: Only one second chance per bite, and you come back with very few hearts.

items.name: Sugar Plum
items.does: Eat it and apples are worth double for a few seconds.
items.weak: No protection at all, and wasted if no apples are near.

items.name: Fire Pepper
items.does: Eat it and fire, embers and heat can't hurt you for a while. You move a little faster too.
items.strong: Fire, embers, lava, the Cinder Crown
items.weak: Does nothing for cold, rocks or enemies, and the speed is hard to steer.

items.name: Mint Leaf
items.does: Eat it and you slow right down for a few seconds.
items.strong: Tight mazes, fast levels, getting out of a jam
items.weak: Slow is slow: timed goals and chasers catch up.

items.name: Glow Berry
items.does: Eat it to light up the dark around you.
items.weak: Useless anywhere that isn't dark.
items.legend: Hidden goals and relics glow too.

items.name: Rock Candy
items.does: Eat it and your head smashes straight through the next rocks or hazards it hits.
items.weak: Walls are still walls, and enemies still bite.

items.name: Royal Jelly
items.does: Eat it and enemies lose interest in you for a few seconds.
items.weak: Hazards don't care what you ate, and bosses only pause.
items.legend: Enemies that touch you while it lasts are stunned.

items.name: Honey Cake
items.does: Eat it and apples are worth double for a few seconds.
items.weak: No protection at all, and wasted if no apples are near.

items.name: Ghost Chili
items.does: Eat it and fire, embers and heat can't hurt you for a while. You move a little faster too.
items.strong: Fire, embers, lava, the Cinder Crown
items.weak: Does nothing for cold, rocks or enemies, and the speed is hard to steer.

items.name: Cool Mint Tea
items.does: Drink it and you slow right down for a few seconds.
items.strong: Tight mazes, fast levels, getting out of a jam
items.weak: Slow is slow: timed goals and chasers catch up.

items.name: Lantern Firefly
items.does: Fetches a nearby apple for you every few seconds, and lights up the dark.
items.weak: Can't fight anything.

items.name: Snip the Crab
items.does: Snips a bee, flea or bramble that gets close.
items.weak: Won't touch ghosts, fire or anything magical.

items.name: Shellby the Turtle
items.does: Takes one hit for you, then needs a while to pull its shell back together.
items.strong: Any one hit from a hazard or enemy
items.weak: Slow to recover, and it can't stop walls.
items.legend: Starts every level with its shell ready, plus one extra.

items.name: Puff the Pufferfish
items.does: Puffs up and pushes chasing enemies away from your head.
items.weak: Hazards that sit still don't care.
items.legend: Bosses lose stamina when it pushes them.

items.name: Sir Seahorse
items.does: Haggles a bigger reward out of every win you bring it along for.
items.weak: A gentleman. Does not fight.
items.legend: Also finds a loot trinket on every win.

items.name: Cinder Salamander
items.does: Gobbles up embers, flames and stingers that get close.
items.weak: Won't touch ice, rocks or anything big.
items.legend: Ember Immunity while it's with you.

items.name: Snowy Owl
items.does: Beats its wings at chasing enemies and pushes them away from your head.
items.weak: Hazards that sit still don't care.
items.legend: Bosses lose stamina when it pushes them, and Rime Immunity.

items.name: Spark Eel
items.does: Zaps a stinger, imp or crab that gets close.
items.weak: Won't touch brambles, fire or rocks.
items.legend: Spark Immunity while it's with you.

items.name: Bristle the Hedgehog
items.does: Curls into a ball and takes one hit for you, then needs a while to uncurl.
items.strong: Any one hit from a hazard or enemy
items.weak: Slow to recover, and it can't stop walls.
items.legend: Starts every level ready, plus one extra, and Barb Immunity.

items.name: Toadstool Toad
items.does: Flicks its tongue at a nearby apple every few seconds and eats it for you.
items.weak: Can't fight anything, and it doesn't light the dark.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double, and Toxin Immunity.

items.name: Pip the Hermit Crab
items.does: Ducks into its shell and takes one hit for you, then needs a while to come back out.
items.strong: Any one hit from a hazard or enemy
items.weak: Slow to recover, and it can't stop walls.
items.legend: Starts every level ready, plus one extra, and Edge Immunity.

items.name: Dart the Gecko
items.does: Darts out and snaps up a bee, wasp or flea that gets close.
items.weak: Won't touch ghosts, fire or anything big.
items.legend: Barb Immunity while it's with you.

items.name: Lamplight Moth
items.does: Flutters off for a nearby apple every few seconds, and glows softly in the dark.
items.weak: Can't fight anything.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double, and Rime Immunity.

items.name: Rune of Plenty
items.does: More apples on the board, and more points for each one.
items.weak: Hazards come faster.

items.name: Rune of Stillness
items.does: You move slower, which gives you time to think.
items.weak: Points are worth less.

items.name: Rune of Fortune
items.does: Much more money from every level.
items.weak: Fewer hearts.

items.name: Rune of Fury
items.does: Bosses tire faster and your bites hit them harder.
items.weak: You take more damage.

items.name: Rune of Echoes
items.does: If you die, you come back once and keep going.
items.strong: Hard levels you just want done
items.weak: The level pays less if the echo saves you.

items.name: Rune of Haste
items.does: Every point is worth more.
items.weak: You move faster.

items.name: Rune of Iron
items.does: Extra armor plates in every level, even with no hearts.
items.weak: Every apple makes you longer.

items.name: Rune of Vigor
items.does: Extra hearts in every level.
items.weak: Hazards come faster.

items.name: Rune of the Magpie
items.does: Trinkets turn up far more often.
items.weak: Points are worth less.

items.name: Rune of the Sage
items.does: Free casts of your spell in every level: they don't spend its charges.
items.weak: Your spell recharges slower between casts.

items.name: Rune of Greed
items.does: A chance of a gem every time you win a level.
items.strong: Saving up for skins and themes
items.weak: Much less money from every level.

items.name: Rune of Calm
items.does: Hazards come slower.
items.weak: Apples are worth fewer points.

items.name: Rune of Grace
items.does: After every hit you're safe for a moment.
items.strong: Busy boards full of things to bump into
items.weak: Fewer hearts.

items.name: Rune of the Pyre
items.does: Fire hurts you less.
items.strong: Fire, embers, lava, the Cinder Crown
items.weak: Ice hurts you more.

items.name: Rune of the Glacier
items.does: Ice and frost hurt you less.
items.weak: Fire hurts you more.

items.name: Rune of the Storm
items.does: Lightning hurts you less.
items.strong: The climb to the last lair, spark beetles
items.weak: Venom hurts you more.

items.name: Rune of the Serpent
items.does: Venom and acid hurt you less.
items.weak: Blades hurt you more.

items.name: Rune of the Bulwark
items.does: Stings, spikes and blades hurt you less.
items.weak: Points are worth less.

items.name: Rune of Spellfire
items.does: Your spells are stronger and have more charges.
items.weak: Fire hurts you more.

items.name: Heart Canister
items.does: Purple hearts on top of your own, lost first. They don't refill between levels, and the jar is gone when they are.
items.strong: Hard levels and boss fights: every purple heart is a free mistake
items.weak: Never sold by merchants. Found on the board now and then, or won from a quest.
items.legend: Five plates of shiny purple armor instead of hearts, four pieces each.

items.name: Reef Cutlass
items.does: A salt-pitted sailor's blade. Kills what you run into, and takes the one beside it.
items.weak: Crabs and knights shrug off an edge.

items.name: Gatehouse Halberd
items.does: An axe and a spear on one pole. Kills what you run into and what's beside it, and takes an extra piece of a boss's armor.
items.strong: Wasps, bees, bosses in their armor, the Keep
items.weak: Two tags, two ways to be resisted: tin knights shrug off both.

items.name: Tide Trident
items.does: Three prongs of cold iron. Spears what you run into, chills what's around it, and freezes a boss it strikes.
items.strong: Fire-born foes, bees, fleas, the Reef
items.weak: Frost sprites and ice floes don't care about its cold.

items.name: Reaper's Scythe
items.does: A long curved blade with a green sheen. Cuts a swath, and a boss it strikes tires half again as fast.
items.weak: Vipers, urchins and wraiths are as poisonous as it is.

items.name: Arc Rapier
items.does: A needle of blue steel that crackles. Kills what you run into, and a kill zaps the next nearest enemy.
items.strong: Knights in tin, crabs, scorpions, groups
items.weak: Spark beetles and the Stormwright laugh at lightning.

items.name: Magma Cleaver
items.does: A slab of glowing iron. Cuts down what you run into and what's beside it, and sets a boss alight.
items.strong: Brambles, ghosts, mantises, bosses of ice and wood
items.weak: The Crown's fire-born things don't feel the heat.

items.name: Tidecaller Helm
items.does: A helm of blue-green shell with a fin down the back.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and fire finds the gaps: Fire Weakness.

items.name: Tidecaller Coat
items.does: A coat of overlapping scales that drips whatever the weather.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and fire finds the gaps: Fire Weakness.

items.name: Obsidian Helm
items.does: A black glass helm with a crest of cooled lava.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and cold bites hard: Ice Weakness.

items.name: Obsidian Plate
items.does: Plates of volcanic glass, sharp-edged and warm to the touch.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and cold bites hard: Ice Weakness.

items.name: Runeweave Hood
items.does: A hood stitched with a running line of glowing glyphs.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and every blade finds you: Slashing Weakness.

items.name: Runeweave Robe
items.does: A long robe woven with ink that never dries.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and every blade finds you: Slashing Weakness.

items.name: Gleaner's Hat
items.does: A wide straw hat with a ribbon, sun-bleached and comfortable.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and barbs find you: Piercing Weakness.

items.name: Gleaner's Smock
items.does: A canvas smock with pockets for everything the harvest drops.
items.weak: Wear the whole set and barbs find you: Piercing Weakness.

items.name: Tidal Surge
items.does: A wave rolls out from you and freezes every hazard and enemy it passes through.
items.weak: A boss only freezes for half as long.
items.legend: A frozen boss loses stamina while it's frozen.

items.name: Ember Rain
items.does: Fire falls on the nearest enemies and hazards, more of them than a single fireball.
items.weak: Can't burn rocks or walls, and the Crown laughs at it.

items.name: Shadow Step
items.does: You slip forward through whatever is in the way, as a shadow.
items.strong: Getting out of a corner, over gates and walls
items.weak: Only goes straight ahead, and it won't drop you in a wall.
items.legend: You're untouchable for a second after landing.

items.name: Storm Aegis
items.does: A crackling dome: it soaks up hazards and enemies, and while it holds you have Electricity Immunity.
items.weak: Walls shatter it at once, and fire-born bosses walk right through it.
items.legend: Also shocks anything it soaks up.

items.name: Harvest Call
items.does: Apples slide toward your head from across the board, and thieves lose interest.
items.weak: No protection at all.

items.name: Hex Bolt
items.does: A bolt of green fire seeks the nearest enemy and poisons it. On a boss it cracks a heart of armor.
items.weak: Vipers, wraiths and urchins are poisonous themselves.
items.legend: Each bolt splits and seeks two targets.

items.name: Harvest Pie
items.does: Eat it to heal hearts.
items.weak: Can't heal past your full hearts.

items.name: Smoked Fish
items.does: Eat it to put charges back in your spell.
items.weak: Does nothing without a spell, or if it's fully charged.

items.name: Bee Balm
items.does: Eat it and enemies lose interest in you for a few seconds.
items.weak: Hazards don't care what you ate.
items.legend: Enemies that touch you while it lasts are stunned.

items.name: Crunch Bar
items.does: Eat it and your head smashes straight through the next rocks or hazards it hits.
items.weak: Walls are still walls, and enemies still bite.

items.name: Rascal the Ferret
items.does: Darts at a nearby apple every few seconds and brings it back to you.
items.weak: Can't fight anything.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double, and Piercing Resistance.

items.name: Mooncrow
items.does: Perches on your shoulder and lights the dark around your head.
items.weak: Does nothing in the light.
items.legend: A wide light, and Spark Resistance.

items.name: Digger the Mole
items.does: Pops up and snaps whatever gets close: a gnasher, a hound, a flea.
items.weak: Won't touch ghosts, fire or anything big.
items.legend: Edge Immunity while it's with you.

items.name: Axel the Axolotl
items.does: Takes a hit for you, then needs a while to grow it back.
items.strong: Any one hit from a hazard or enemy
items.weak: Slow to recover, and it can't stop walls.
items.legend: Starts every level ready, plus one extra, and Rime Immunity.

items.name: Echo the Bat
items.does: Screeches at chasing enemies and shoves them away from your head.
items.weak: Hazards that sit still don't care.
items.legend: Bosses lose stamina when it shoves them.

items.name: Biscuit the Pup
items.does: Sniffs out a nearby apple every few seconds and fetches it.
items.weak: Can't fight anything, and it doesn't light the dark.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double, and Barb Immunity.

items.name: Rune of Mending
items.does: After every hit you're safe a little longer.
items.weak: Apples are worth less.

items.name: Rune of the Anvil
items.does: Extra armor plates in every level.
items.strong: Hits you can't dodge, the Crown
items.weak: You move faster.

items.name: Rune of Thorns
items.does: Stings, spikes and arrows hurt you less.
items.weak: Blades hurt you more.

items.name: Rune of the Tide
items.does: Ice and lightning hurt you less.
items.strong: The Reef, the Spire, the climb
items.weak: Fire hurts you more.

items.name: Rune of the Scholar
items.does: Your spells are stronger.
items.weak: Half a heart less.

items.name: Rune of the Hunt
items.does: Every blow on a boss lands harder.
items.weak: You take more damage.
